opennyai_summary.10_January_2025__facts:
This application under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 has been filed by the petitioner, namely, Wilson Hasda @ Tudu, son of Hemen Hasda, seeking bail in Gossaigaon P.S. Case No. 175/2024 registered under Sections 376/420 IPC read with Section 6 POCSO Act, wherein he was arrested on 24.10.2024 and is in custody since then.
During the deliberation of the matter, Mr. Goswami, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam,
on instructions submitted that police after completion of investigation of the case has already submitted charge-sheet in the said Gossaigaon P.S. Case No. 175/2024 vide Charge-Sheet No.
150/2024 dated 30.11.2024.
opennyai_summary.10_January_2025__decision:
In view of the above, the petitioner may approach the appropriate forum for his regular bail in said Gossaigaon P.S. Case No. 175/2024.
With the above observation and direction, this bail application stands disposed of.
